GAB.note: Seed fund is French embassy financed, not a Gabonese state measure.

facts.fact: Gabonmediatime reports that on 26 January 2024 the 4th edition of the Cohorte Innovation 4.0 acceleration programme launched at the SING digital incubation company, with 20 start-ups admitted and 10 to get seed funding, followed by the Panthere incubation programme.
